suite: TPC-H-derived/canonical subset, not a full standard TPC-H score
methodology: Fresh release worker per query/config; one warm execution and five complete query executions including builds and typed output collection; loading/serialization/checking excluded; CPU-only; no concurrent builds during timing.
resumption: Initial all-query run completed21 kernels then outer deadline expired during original H09 counting. Reused63 completed rows; cardinality-reordered H09 and seven remaining kernels completed via per-query invocations after default-branch merge. Original H09 baseline preserved separately.
h09: Enumerated18 connected Part-first orders using exact local prefix cardinalities. Measured both minimum-prefix composite-Lineitem order and upstream single-key-Lineitem order; selected latter because all three configurations are faster. Not a globally proven runtime optimum; see preserved candidate and original-written measurements.
counter_limitations: Hash-computation differences show executed hashing changes, not a complete provider inventory. RadixRun heap and direct range iteration are not fully represented by legacy memory/row counters; do not compare reported retained-byte counters as full footprint measurements.
